name: LLM7.io
description: Zero-friction OpenAI-compatible API that works without signup and speeds up with a free token.
overview: LLM7.io is a free OpenAI-compatible endpoint that can be called with no signup at a low base rate, or with a free email token for 1 request/second, 60/minute and 250/hour plus a 100,000-token daily cap. The catalog mixes open models such as Nemotron 3 Nano, GLM 5.3 Flash, Mistral Nemo and DeepSeek V4 Flash.
free_access: No signup needed: call the API with a placeholder key at ~30 RPM
A free email token raises limits to 1 req/s, 60/min and 250/hour
100,000 tokens per 24 hours on the free token
notes: Anonymous use is throttled hardest (about 30 RPM); the token tier's daily cap can be reduced without notice.
